core_rule: The runner may report warnings, but no finding may affect PASS/FAIL unless it is candidate-bound, in active first-party scope, reproducible, normalized, deduplicated, and either directly proven or governed by an exact evidence-backed rule.

current_known_state.candidate_origin: Stage071N V4 R1 cold-validated bootable OS checkpoint

determinism_gates: Same candidate plus same tool versions must yield the same normalized finding ledger.
Scope manifest must hash-match every included file and explain every exclusion class.
All raw reports must hash-match the evidence manifest.
A second normalization pass over the same reports must produce byte-identical blocker output.
execution_sequence: Run the self-contained V4 R3 package against the bundled candidate.
Ingest the complete raw return and deduplicate/adjudicate candidate-bound findings.
Repair confirmed defects in a quarantined copy.
Run local regressions and freeze a repaired noncanonical candidate.
Run a fresh V4 inspection against the repaired digest.
If V4 returns PASS, rerun all six candidate-bound M14 lanes for that digest.
false_positive_controls: No blanket ignores and no threshold lowering.
Every suppression must be exact-path, exact-rule, candidate-digest-bound, evidence-backed, time-limited, and independently reviewable.
Test/fixture/generated material is removed from active scope instead of broadly suppressed.
Dependency findings require package ecosystem and authoritative fixed-version evidence.
Secret findings require proof that the value is live/non-placeholder before becoming a blocker.
Archive traversal and command-injection findings require a reachable path or a reproducing attack fixture before becoming blockers.
A scanner disagreement remains visible; it cannot be silently discarded.
prohibited_shortcuts: Do not make V4 pass by hiding findings.
Do not reuse old candidate-bound PASS receipts as certification for a new digest.
Do not mutate the live root or canonical pointer.
Do not authorize M08B, credentials, crawler activation, or external writes.
purpose: Make V4 produce a trustworthy PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED verdict without counting unproven or out-of-scope findings as blockers.

candidate: Repair confirmed undefined names and missing atomic-writer imports.
Repair duplicate dictionary keys, import redefinitions, and syntax defects.
Repair confirmed unsafe archive extraction paths.
Remove or safely constrain shell=True command execution.
Repair GitHub Actions context interpolation that can reach shell commands.
Run local regressions before freezing a new noncanonical candidate digest.
harness: Invoke SAST tools with the exact file manifest rather than recursive dot scans.
Exclude fixtures, backups, generated evidence, archived packets, vendor trees, and duplicate roots before scanning.
Preserve raw stdout, stderr, JSON, command line, version, start/end time, and exit code for every tool.
Normalize candidate-relative paths and deduplicate identical findings by tool/rule/path/line/fingerprint.
Cluster cross-tool reports of the same root cause without discarding source reports.
Treat parser errors, unsupported files, missing reports, and incomplete mypy execution as BLOCKED rather than PASS.
Include Trivy secret results and Semgrep scanner errors in the summary and verdict.
Use ecosystem-aware dependency adjudication so distro backports are not mislabeled by generic version matching.
Ship a top-level RUN_ANALYZERS.cmd and cold-test extraction, WSL path conversion, output copy, and sidecar creation.

success_semantics.blocked: Any missing tool, parse/coverage gap, corrupt report, candidate mismatch, or incomplete scan.
success_semantics.candidate_pass: Runner success plus zero unresolved true blockers after exact candidate repairs.
success_semantics.fail: At least one unresolved true blocker remains.
success_semantics.pass: Zero unresolved true blockers and zero coverage/integrity gaps.
success_semantics.runner_success: All eight analyzers execute completely, reports are preserved, scope and candidate binding verify, parser coverage is complete, and verdict generation is deterministic.

supersession.reason: Historical candidate bytes were unavailable; user required the candidate to ship inside the runner bundle.
